The A-Mei Teahouse is the most famous — its tiered outdoor seating overlooks the entire lantern-lit street below. Go hungry: the street food here (sweet taro balls, grass jelly, red yeast rice pork) is among the best in Taiwan.",
     "九份老街陡峭的石砌階梯巷弄在黃昏時蛻變，數百盞紅燈籠相繼亮起，狹窄街道化身宮崎駿電影場景。下午3點抵達可在人潮與燈籠點亮前探索，然後在接近下午5點時佔據上層茶館露台之一，拍攝燈籠一盞接一盞亮起的畫面。阿妹茶樓最負盛名 — 階梯式露天座位俯瞰下方整條燈籠照亮的老街。空著肚子來：這裡的街頭美食（芋圓、仙草、紅糟豬肉）是台灣最好吃的之一。"),

    ('title: "Houtong Cat Village Railway Tunnel"',
     'title: "猴硐貓村鐵路隧道"'),
    ("The old coal mining railway tunnel at Houtong is where most of the village's cats spend their afternoons — cool, dark, and lined with cat beds and volunteer feeding stations. The tunnel is most atmospheric in the early evening when the cats are freshest.",
     "猴硐舊煤礦鐵路隧道是多數村莊貓咪度過下午時光的地方 — 涼爽、幽暗，兩側排列著貓咪床鋪與志工餵食站。打開手機手電筒（頭燈更佳）走過隧道，在每個壁龕都能發現貓咪。地面上村庄裡，屋頂、窗台、長椅上都有貓。志工們很友善，會為您介紹住戶貓咪的名字。向志工攤位購買貓咪造型餅乾（NT 30）餵食入口附近較溫順的貓。黃昏初期是隧道最有氛圍的時刻，貓咪最為精神。"),

    ('title: "Taipei Zoo Scavenger Hunt"',

    ("A fun competitive challenge for your last day: split up at the zoo entrance and race to find and photograph 10 animals on a checklist in 90 minutes. Animals on the list include the Formosan black bear (playful, near entrance pool on hot days), koala (sleeping, look up in the eucalypts), penguin (waddling, near the Australian zone), giraffe (eating, best seen from the monorail), flamingo (standing on one leg), orangutan, giant panda (if you're lucky and it's awake), seal, red-crowned crane, and saltwater crocodile.      "最後一天有趣的比赛：於園區入口分頭行動，在90分鐘內比賽找出並拍攝清單上的10種動物。獎品：贏家選擇珍珠奶茶的地點。清單上的動物包括：台灣黑熊（天熱時在入口水池附近玩耍）、無尾熊（在尤佳利樹上睡覺，仰頭找）、企鵝（在澳洲區附近搖搖晃晃）、長頸鹿（在吃東西，從單軌車上看得最清楚）、紅鶴（單腳站立）、紅毛猩猩、大熊貓（幸運的話剛好醒著）、海豹、丹頂鶴、鹹水鱷魚。TPass 可免費入園；上午9點抵達動物最為活潑。搭單軌車（NT 5）至上層園區，省走路。"),

    # Day 07 gallery — Maokong Gondola
    ('title: "Maokong Crystal Gondola"',
     'title: "貓空水晶纜車"'),
    ("Upgrade to a Crystal Cabin — the same ticket price as a standard cabin, just ask at the station — for a 30-minute ride with a transparent floor over the forest canopy at 439m above sea level. The glass floor makes you feel like you're floating above the treetops. On clear days you can see Taipei 101, Guanyin Mountain, and the Tamsui coastline all in one view. The gondola departs every 15 minutes from Taipei Zoo Station. Arrive early afternoon for the best light; late afternoon rides catch the sunset over the city. The cable crosses above dense forest and tea plantation patches — look straight down through the crystal floor for a vertigo-inducing view.",
     "升級水晶車廂 — 票價與普通車廂相同，只需在站上告知 — 30分鐘車程，透明車底懸浮於海拔439公尺的森林樹冠之上。玻璃車底讓您彷彿漂浮於樹梢。晴朗時一眼可覽台北101、觀音山與淡水海岸線。纜車每15分鐘從台北市立動物園站發車。下午早些抵達光線最佳；傍晚班次可捕捉城市夕陽。纜線穿越茂密森林與零星茶園 — 透過水晶車底俯瞰，令人暈眩的景色。"),
    ('cost: "NT 130 return · Crystal Cabin +NT 80 · Taipei Zoo Station"',
     'cost: "NT 130 來回 · 水晶車廂 +NT 80 · 台北市立動物園站"'),

    # Day 07 gallery — Maokong Tea
    ('title: "Maokong Tea Plantation Trail & Teahouse"',
     'title: "貓空茶園步道與茶館"'),
    ("A 3km paved trail through tea plantations starting from the Maokong terminal station — flat, shaded, and perfect for a post-gondola walk. At the end of the trail, settle into one of the mountaintop teahouses with an outdoor terrace overlooking the city. Order a pot of iced Tieguanyin — the local high-mountain oolong grown in the mist above Taipei — and toast to the week. Most teahouses have cold-brewed versions perfect for the June heat. Buy a bag of tea to take home (NT 200-400 for 100g).",
     "從貓空終點站出發的3公里鋪設步道，穿梭茶園之間 — 平坦、遮蔭，是纜車後的完美散步路線。步道經過正在運作的茶園，可見茶農手工採茶，背景是台北市區與觀音山。步道終點，落座山頂茶館的露天陽台，俯瞰城市景觀。點一壺冰鐵觀音 — 這是台北山區霧氣中種植的高山烏龍茶 — 為這一周乾杯。多數茶館有冷泡版本，非常適合六月暑氣。選購一包茶葉帶回家（NT 200-400/100公克）。"),
    ('cost: "Tea pot NT 150-300 · Trail free · Buy tea NT 200-400/100g"',

        has_cjk = bool(re.search(r'[\u4e00-\u9fff]', m))
        has_eng = bool(re.search(r'[a-zA-Z]{3,}', m))
        if has_eng and not has_cjk:
            # Skip code
            skip = {
                'images/', 'Arial', 'parent', 'cover', 'bold', 'italic',

    """Replace a #par block, matching brackets correctly."""
    idx = content.find(start_text)

        print(f"Not found: {label}")
        return False
    
    # Find opening [
    open_idx = content.find('[', idx)
    if open_idx < 0:
        print(f"No [ found: {label}")
        return False
    
    # Find matching closing ] - count nesting
    depth = 1
    pos = open_idx + 1
    while pos < len(content) and depth > 0:
        if content[pos] == '[':
            depth += 1
        elif content[pos] == ']':
            depth -= 1
        pos += 1
    
    if depth != 0:
        print(f"Could not find matching ]: {label}")
        return False
    
    old = content[open_idx:pos]
